extracted.intended_audience: readers, writers, teachers, and students of concise literary nonfiction (flash/brief creative nonfiction)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and topical indexing for craft essays focused on concise literary nonfiction (flash nonfiction), covering craft elements, modes/forms, topics, and pedagogical resources. The page is an archive/index to locate craft essays addressing these dimensions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Concision / Flash form
rubrics_metrics.description: Brevity: A Journal of Concise Literary Nonfiction — the site focuses on concise literary nonfiction and includes reflections on the flash form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The archive and craft essays examine the flash form specifically and the larger imperative of concision in literary nonfiction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Characterization
rubrics_metrics.description: Essays exploring the craft of characterization.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tagged in the 'Essays by Craft Element' index so writers can find pieces addressing how to render character in brief nonfiction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Voice
rubrics_metrics.description: Essays exploring the craft of voice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Considered a core craft element; searchable via the craft-element index.

rubrics_metrics.name: Image
rubrics_metrics.description: Essays exploring the craft of image.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Included among craft elements that essays highlight when discussing choices in concise nonfiction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Syntax
rubrics_metrics.description: Essays exploring the craft of syntax.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses sentence-level choices and their effect within compressed forms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Structure
rubrics_metrics.description: Essays exploring the craft of structure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes approaches to arranging material in short-form nonfiction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dialogue
rubrics_metrics.description: Dialogue identified as a craft element to be explored in essays.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as an example tag in the 'Essays by Craft Element' index for locating discussion of using dialogue in brief nonfiction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Extended metaphor
rubrics_metrics.description: Extended metaphor identified as a craft element to be explored in essays.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Appears as an example craft choice in the archive tagging system.

rubrics_metrics.name: Segmentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Segmentation (the breaking up/organization of material) identified as a craft element.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Searchable tag; relates to ways to divide or sequence content in short nonfiction forms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Speculation
rubrics_metrics.description: Speculation identified as a craft element/choice addressed by essays.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes use of conjecture, imaginative leaps, or reflective hypotheticals within nonfiction pieces.

rubrics_metrics.name: Modes / Forms (list, letter, lyric essay, meditation, profile, etc.)
rubrics_metrics.description: The archive indexes essays by particular nonfiction forms such as list, letter, lyric essay, meditation, profile, and more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the 'Essays by Mode' index to find craft guidance specific to these forms and their conventions in concise nonfiction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Topic-focused approaches
rubrics_metrics.description: Essays touching on particular issues and topics, including addiction, class, gender, sexuality, race and ethnicity, illness, parenting, spirituality, and more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Topic tags allow locating craft discussions that engage subject-matter-specific considerations and ethical/representational concerns in writing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Author interviews
rubrics_metrics.description: Author interviews included among craft essays.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interviews serve as practical, example-driven insight into craft choices and the writing life.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reflections on the writing life
rubrics_metrics.description: Essays include reflections on many aspects of the writing life beyond technical craft (e.g., career/practice considerations).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These pieces address broader professional and personal aspects that inform craft choices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Searchable indexing (by craft element, mode, topic)
rubrics_metrics.description: The site provides searchable indexes ('Essays by Craft Element', 'Essays by Mode', 'Essays by Topic') to locate essays that highlight particular craft elements, forms, or topics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical navigation tool for readers/teachers/students to find targeted craft guidance; implies organization of craft advice around these dimensions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Teaching resources
rubrics_metrics.description: A section for Teaching Resources related to concise literary nonfiction craft.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates availability of pedagogical materials aimed at teachers or workshop leaders working with flash nonfiction and craft essays.
